title: Supreme Court initiates suo motu case on need to speed up hearing in matters on life saving drugs
description: The Supreme Court has registered a suo motu case to curb delays when it comes decisions on cases involving access to life-saving drugs [In Re: Access to Life-Saving Medicines and Judicial Expediency in Article 21 Matters].A Bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V Mohana issued notice in the matter today.Pertinently, it also indicated that it may lay down pan-India guidelines toe ensure the timely adjudication of such life-and-liberty matters.Chief Justice of Ind
